text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency breach for customer 'aurora-health' (VPC dedicated-eu2). Trigger: p99 > 2.5s over 5m. Paging oncall-sre-josh and eng-runtime-aya.
oncall-sre-josh: I'm on it. joining war room.
eng-runtime-aya: looking at svc metrics now. p95 ~ 700ms but p99 shot to 3.2s on eu2-dedicated pool.
eng-ml-kevin: tagging in — what's the model and sequence distribution?
eng-runtime-aya: model is gpt-small-q4, avg seq len 280 tokens for this tenant, bursts of long conversations, KV cache hit drops for tenant.
acct-mgr-linda: FYI I just got pinged by Marta (customer-sre). She says customer is seeing timeouts in their UI and some automated jobs failing.
customer-sre-marta: Confirming — we have customers complaining, sporadic timeouts on interactive flows. Severity high.
ops-lead-omar: Any recent deploys?
eng-runtime-aya: No deploys in last 30m. No config rollouts. GPU utilization on dedicated-eu2 is at 92% and queue length spiking.
infra-nina: Checking infra metrics — a subset of nodes (pool eu2-dedicated-8..eu2-dedicated-11) have higher RTs. I see one evicted GPU process recently, OOM on node eu2-dedicated-10 at 12:07:42 UTC.
oncall-sre-josh: OOM could explain KV cache thrashing. Can we isolate tenant traffic to stop noisy neighbor?
eng-runtime-aya: Recommend immediate tenant isolation (throttle/evict) to reduce tail. If that reduces p99 we can plan controlled reinstate.
eng-ml-kevin: Also suggests temporarily routing aurora-health to their warm-spare region (eu1) while we stabilize. Model is available there.
acct-mgr-linda: Customer asked for minimal disruption — they prefer throttling over full failover. Can we do a soft throttle first?
eng-runtime-aya: Soft throttle -> reduce concurrency from 20 to 4 for tenant aurora-health. Will also enable prefix KV warming policy.
eng-runtime-aya: Running isolation command:
```
rctl tenant-isolate --tenant=aurora-health --pool=dedicated-eu2 --mode=soft --concurrency=4
```
ops-lead-omar: go for it.
eng-runtime-aya: Applied. Confirming changes...
eng-runtime-aya: @infra-nina can you confirm drain/evict on overloaded node eu2-dedicated-10?
infra-nina: Initiating controlled eviction of GPU processes on eu2-dedicated-10, migrating pods: `kubectl cordon eu2-dedicated-10 && kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets eu2-dedicated-10`
eng-ml-kevin: Noted — recompute KV cache warming for tenant on eu2-dedicated-11 to avoid cold-start waves.
eng-runtime-aya: Enabling KV warming: `./kv-warm --tenant aurora-health --target-nodes eu2-dedicated-11,eu2-dedicated-12 --batch 64`
oncall-sre-josh: p99 telemetry after throttle: 1m window shows drop from 3.2s -> 1.6s. p95 stable ~700ms. Good sign.
customer-sre-marta: Customer seeing some improvement but still intermittent slow tail for long sequences. They want ETA for full remediation.
eng-runtime-aya: ETA: 15-25m to rebalance KV cache and finish node eviction. We'll monitor.
eng-ml-kevin: Suggest limiting max seq length for this tenant temporarily to 1024 tokens to avoid runaway decode cost. This can be opt-in on the app layer or via serving policy.
eng-runtime-aya: Can apply serving policy:
```
serve-policies apply --tenant aurora-health --max-seq 1024 --reject-if-over 1050
```
acct-mgr-linda: I'll relay that to customer and propose the temporary limit.
ops-lead-omar: Impact assessment: traffic pre-throttle 120 qps, currently after soft throttle ~30 qps accepted. Error rate dropped from 2.3% -> 0.4%.
eng-runtime-aya: We're also scheduling a canary shift if p99 remains <1.8s for 10m — move a portion of traffic to eu1 warm-spare with gradual weighted routing.
eng-ml-kevin: Reminder: copying model variant from eu2 -> eu1 can incur cache warmups; prefer traffic split vs bulk migration.
customer-sre-marta: Acceptable. They authorize routing up to 20% to eu1 for relief.
eng-runtime-aya: Kicking off weighted routing: `routectrl route --from pool:dedicated-eu2 --to pool:dedicated-eu1 --tenant aurora-health --weight 10%`
incident-bot: NOTE: Routing change scheduled by eng-runtime-aya at 12:26:10 UTC. Auto-rollback if latency > 2.5s for 5m.
eng-runtime-aya: After 7m weighted routing + throttle: p99 steady at 1.4-1.7s, p95 ~650ms. Queue length normalized.
oncall-sre-josh: We're still seeing a small error spike on POST /v1/generate with 500s originating from eu2-dedicated-12 — investigating logs.
eng-runtime-aya: Pulling logs: `journalctl -u redwood-inference | grep eu2-dedicated-12 | tail -n 200`
eng-runtime-aya: Found repeated OOM kill pattern from outlier worker handling long-history decodes. We've limited concurrency and increased OOM score adjustment.
infra-nina: Patching kubelet memory limit on node eu2-dedicated-12 to reduce OOM churn. Patching now.
eng-ml-kevin: After node patch + throttle, KV hit rate increased from 61% -> 84% for aurora-health. That explains latency improvement.
customer-sre-marta: Customer verified interactive flows recovered for majority of users. Still seeing a few timeouts in long-batch jobs — they can retry after 10m.
acct-mgr-linda: They want a post-incident writeup and root cause. I'll coordinate.
eng-runtime-aya: Immediate next steps: 1) Keep soft throttle for 30m, 2) finish full node migration and allow gradual concurrency restore, 3) run deeper RCA on OOM cause (memory leak or model change), 4) schedule dedicated capacity bump if usage stays high.
eng-ml-kevin: I'll start reproducer run with long-history sequences in staging to test memory patterns.
ops-lead-omar: I'll draft rollback playbook in case p99 resurges.
devex-ryan: Noted for docs — add a short-runbook for 'tenant soft isolate' and routing migration steps.
eng-runtime-aya: Will keep thread updated every 5m.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident severity downgraded to P2 at 12:46:33 UTC due to improved customer impact and mitigation in place.
oncall-sre-josh: Leaving follow-up actions for next shift: RCA, memory profiling, decision on reserved capacity. Tagging eng-runtime-aya and eng-ml-kevin as owners.
acct-mgr-linda: Thanks team. Marta — I'll follow up with a customer update in 30m and coordinate postmortem.
customer-sre-marta: Thanks all. Will watch and escalate if anything regresses.
eng-runtime-aya: final note: timeline summary — 12:06 alert, 12:10 soft throttle + KV warm, 12:18 weighted route 10% to eu1, 12:26 OOM patch, 12:46 P2 downgrade.
eng-ml-kevin: I'll attach profiling artifacts to the postmortem.
eng-runtime-aya: thread closing in 30m unless regression.
incident-bot: This thread will auto-close in 48h if no activity."
